name: GHGSat global-landfill reviewed null-observation metadata audit
research_question: Can the released GHGSat global-landfill survey independently provide enough licensed, reviewed morning-orbit non-detections in MARS-disjoint geography to justify a later audit for at least 28 Sentinel-2 L1C or Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-1 pairs within one hour?

decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.anti_pooling_boundary: GHGSat must pass every metadata gate and later contribute at least 28 qualifying target pairs by itself. It may supplement the already-qualified 272-pair MARS-Hyperspectral cohort only after doing so; it may not pool with any failed candidate to satisfy a gate.
decision_context_disclosed_before_freeze.record_page_preview_observed_before_free: The public Zenodo record page disclosed the schema, a limited CSV preview, rounded file size, MD5, license, and download URL. The complete CSV has not been downloaded or enumerated locally.

authoritative_source.dataset_title: GHGSat plume dataset for article "Global satellite survey reveals uncertainty in landfill methane emissions"

paper.title: Global satellite survey reveals uncertainty in landfill methane emissions

orbit_timing_source.title: An Independent Evaluation of GHGSat Methane Emissions: Performance Assessment
orbit_timing_source.frozen_interpretation: The peer-reviewed platform table reports local descending-node times of 10:30 for C1-C2 and 13:00 for C3-C5. Only sat_ID 1 or 2 may contribute to the morning target-pair headroom gate.

license_contract.copyright_notice: Copyright 2025 GHGSat, Inc. All Rights Reserved
license_contract.interpretation: The explicit Creative Commons license grants non-commercial research reuse subject to attribution and share-alike even though GHGSat retains copyright.
obligations: attribute the dataset creators, GHGSat, record DOI, and Nature paper in research outputs
use the dataset and derivatives only for non-commercial research unless separately licensed
apply CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 or a compatible share-alike treatment to redistributed dataset derivatives
mark any materially trained distributed checkpoint non-commercial and attribution/share-alike constrained, or withhold redistribution pending license review
never describe a non-detection as physical zero methane

label_contract.source_claim: A clear-sky GHGSat observation of a reviewed waste-disposal site in which no localized methane plume was detected above the applicable GHGSat sensitivity.
not_claimed: scene-wide absence of every methane source
absence below the GHGSat detection limit
absence at a Sentinel-2 or Landsat acquisition taken at another time
label_contract.paper_outcomes: Each site observation is categorized as no detected plume, one detected plume, or multiple detected plumes. Multiple positive plume rows are aggregated to one positive observation for count reconciliation.
null_row_contract: the grouped observation contains no positive row

required_internal_consistency: calendar fields reproduce date as an exact UTC timestamp
all rows in one observation identity have identical time and satellite fields
each observation is exclusively null or positive
all null and positive rows satisfy the frozen field semantics
every null site has at least one finite positive plume coordinate from another released observation

site_coordinate_rule.reason: Released null rows intentionally carry zero coordinate sentinels, so a deterministic site representative must be derived without a target catalog or model output.
site_coordinate_rule.candidate_points: All finite, non-zero released positive-row (lat, lon) coordinates for the same site_ID after positive-row validation.
site_coordinate_rule.representative: The candidate point minimizing the sum of haversine distances to every candidate point for that site. Ties are resolved by ascending latitude, longitude, then original CSV row number.
site_coordinate_rule.failure: A null site without a valid representative or with a coordinate span above the frozen maximum is invalid and cannot be retained; any invalid released observation fails the all-records-valid gate.

deterministic_null_selection.ranking: ascending (SHA-256(site_ID + NUL + obs_ID + NUL + date UTF-8), obs_ID, date)
deterministic_null_selection.selection_timing: after complete population and label validation, before MARS/prior-negative distance filtering or target-catalog access

exclude_if_within_radius_of: any official MARS-S2L test representative location
any already-counted MARS-Hyperspectral negative source crop
geographic_eligibility.grouping: Transitive connected components of retained site representatives with an undirected edge at haversine distance <=25.0 km.
geographic_eligibility.novel_component_requirement: Every member of a counted component must be strictly farther than 25 km from every protected MARS or prior-negative point.

metadata_gates.population: Deterministically selected C1/C2 reviewed null observations after frozen MARS and prior-negative exclusions.

threshold_rationale.minimum_selected_morning_null_observatio: Twice the unchanged 28-pair target requirement is required as preregistered headroom before any target-catalog query. This is a feasibility gate, not an assumed 50 percent pairing rate.
threshold_rationale.minimum_distinct_null_sites: Prevents a pass dominated by repeated acquisitions from a small number of landfills.
threshold_rationale.minimum_novel_25km_connected_components: Unchanged spatial-diversity gate used for the independent negative-source search.

permitted_after_this_protocol_is_committ: one download of the exact frozen CSV URL within the byte cap
HTTP redirects and headers required to verify the exact CSV identity
forbidden: Plume_rasters.zip or any GHGSat raster/image asset
any Sentinel-2 or Landsat target-catalog query or target asset
any protected MARS outcome, mask, prediction, score, or threshold result
any official MARS test outcome column
any change to a gate after the CSV is opened

target_catalog_boundary.eligible_source_observations: Only retained GHGSat C1/C2 reviewed null observations from this audit.

failure_action: Retire the GHGSat landfill-null supplement without changing a threshold, querying a target catalog, or pooling another failed source.
pass_action: Commit a separate exact target-catalog pairing protocol before any Sentinel-2 or Landsat query.
claim_boundary: A PASS establishes licensed metadata feasibility for reviewed, source-site-level GHGSat C1/C2 non-detections only. It does not establish physical zero methane, a coincident Sentinel-2/Landsat yield, dense negative validity, cross-sensor transfer, model complementarity, calibration, or superiority over MARS-S2L.
